parallel.requirements: The parallel run recognized the clean-room requirement and the need to match the observed nsh shell behavior without source, wrapping, or internet lookup.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent chose a two-phase plan: first an 11-agent probe swarm writing behavior specs, then parent-led architecture and implementation.
parallel.implementation: No replacement source tree, parser, shell evaluator, build script, or compile-ready implementation was produced before cancellation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The delivered artifact contained docs, the original executable, and generated specs, but no integrated reimplementation or build entry point.
parallel.verification: Verification stayed at behavior-probing and spec-writing; no candidate implementation existed for differential or official-style testing.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Implementation, integration, build packaging, and end-to-end acceptance were still pending, so the official evaluator failed at compile time.

serial.requirements: The serial run also recognized the clean-room benchmark rules and probed the executable and bundled docs without delegation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One main actor owned probing, modeling, future implementation, differential testing, and final packaging in a single local sequence.
serial.implementation: The serial run reached a precise behavior model and an explicit start-coding point but wrote no replacement source or build scaffold.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The delivered artifact contained only the original repository docs and executable, with no new implementation deliverable.
serial.verification: It verified many observed behaviors through direct probes but had no candidate implementation to compare or submit.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Coding, build setup, integration, and final verification were not reached, so the official evaluator also failed at compile time.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized that it had to infer behavior from the binary and documentation and then write a new implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same clean-room implementation requirement and worked only from local behavior observations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement misunderstanding separates the official outcomes; both failed because neither delivered code.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed all first-phase work into 11 behavior-probing children and left implementation to a later parent-led phase.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept probing and future implementation ownership in one actor through a local todo plan.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel separated investigation from implementation through child reports; serial moved linearly from probing toward coding.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs scoped separate behavior domains and returned specs, including contradictions that the parent still needed to reconcile.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated probe findings in one context and refined the expansion and runtime model directly before coding.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had child-to-parent handoff and reconciliation overhead; serial had no child interface boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel artifact members show generated specs but no Rust source, Cargo project, compile script, or replacement executable implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact members show only the original docs and executable, likewise no replacement implementation files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced more intermediate spec material; neither path reached implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The swarm returned completed probe reports that the parent began consuming for Phase B design.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve and continued from its local probe state.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a full child result join before implementation; serial had no join lifecycle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children shared temp and HOME paths; one child found probe outputs from other concurrent actors and switched namespaces.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no subagents and cleaned its own stray probe file before continuing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had cross-agent auxiliary artifact contamination; serial only had single-actor local artifact management.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel verified oracle behavior through probes but never had a candidate implementation for differential testing or evaluator-aligned testing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified many oracle behaviors inline but never had a candidate implementation to test.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both lacked acceptance on a deliverable; parallel verification was packaged as child specs, while serial verification stayed local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after Phase A and initial Phase B design; the active turn was cancelled before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out and was cancelled just after planning to start coding.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both closed unfinished, but parallel consumed its window on child-spec generation before implementation, whereas serial's local probing reached coding intent.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant: both modes failed compile with zero tests passed because neither delivered a clean-room implementation or build scaffold. The parallel run differs materially in process because an 11-child behavior-spec phase completed before implementation began, and because concurrent probe artifacts contaminated child observations, but these are adverse parallel process patterns rather than an explanation for a different evaluator outcome.
parallel_contributors: The parallel run deferred implementation until after the child probing swarm returned.
The parallel run delivered specs and documentation, not a compile-ready implementation.
Concurrent children shared temp and HOME paths, causing probe contamination and re-verification.
serial_contributors: The serial run probed inline and reached a start-coding intent before cancellation.
The serial run also delivered no implementation files or build scaffold.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel produced many behavior spec files while serial only accumulated local observations.
Neither run reached coding, so no ordinary code-level defect can explain a score difference.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained patterns are parallel-side adverse process episodes
